declared_before: any development evaluation of a trained locator

fallback_family.name: fpn_heatmap_line_locator_line_head_tail
fallback_family.input: EXIF-normalized full source image, aspect-preserving letterbox to a square
fallback_family.output: stride-4 heatmaps: national-ID line mask, first-two-digit head, last-two-digit tail
fallback_family.geometry: rotated rectangle from the highest-mass line component; reading direction from head/tail centroids
fallback_family.training_data: external_train inner-fit records only, synthetic scene augmentation

search_space.second_seed_policy: trained only if both first-seed sizes fail the selection constraints
search_space.context_derivation: canonical 1000x630 broad band [350,430,1000,610] around the median calibration digit extent (~437..978): left 87/541=0.16, right 22/541=0.04; both contexts give band width 1.2 x line length and the frozen 650:180 aspect

selection_rule.data: external_train inner holdout only (15% of duplicate groups); seeded native, tight, embedded, off_frame scenes plus line_absent and no_card negatives
selection_rule.objective: maximize the rate of COMPLETE bands containing all 14 digit quads on scenes whose 14 digits are all visible

definitions.localization_success: localized AND rotated IoU(predicted line rectangle, true 14-digit line rectangle) >= 0.5 AND reading-direction cosine >= 0.9
definitions.full_line_containment: every corner of all 14 true digit quadrilaterals lies inside the final band quadrilateral with at most 1 source pixel tolerance
definitions.complete_band: band_state == complete_band (localized, head and tail evidence, line inside source frame, length/height and resolution minima)
definitions.false_complete_on_clipped: complete_band on a scene where at least one digit quadrilateral is not fully inside the source frame
definitions.false_localization: localized on a scene with no visible national-ID line

decision_mapping.PREPROCESSING_REPAIR_NOT_VALIDATED: any localization, containment, or safety gate fails
decision_mapping.DIRECT_FIELD_FALLBACK_SHADOW_ONLY: localization, containment, and safety pass but a coverage gate fails
